resources.budget_rule: Retain cumulative debit and the existing absolute deadline without reset. Before actual execution set the available wall-time cap to min(196.206255477 seconds minus any later debit, 1792122617.77407 minus current Unix time minus stop reserve). If this cap is nonpositive, emit typed HOLD under the existing allocation; do not run or create a new deadline.

nodes.owner: Coding owner, fresh independent reviewer and stage publisher
nodes.action: Accept only the scoped reviewed implementation; publish the standard-library runtime, contract, bundled successful receipt, actual dependency files and prompt-only handoff.
nodes.completion_evidence: C9 scoped review plus actual commit/archive identity and publication acknowledgement; pin the reviewed code commit or record fetched branch HEAD without a self-referential future commit
nodes.publication_transition: This C10 tree is published only after archive backups acknowledge completion and its Git ref update succeeds; actual identity is recorded in DELIVERY_LOG and publisher response.

nodes.action: Automatically fetch the published runtime through an existing authenticated repository or actual archive location into a fresh directory. Load the bundled successful receipt and inspect its existing raw paths. Use explicit --runs-root and --bindings-root options only for an existing relocated owner cache.
nodes.input_identity: Keep every original expected SHA256. Resolve complete history/abundance files and small config/source/terminal/binding files; compressed display tables are not replacements.
nodes.hold: Named missing or mismatched input; null new metrics. No solver launch, render replay, bulk raw attachment or automatic new data acquisition.

nodes.owner: Receiving owner-side executor under retained budget
nodes.execution_cap: Use a finite outer wall-time cap of min(current remaining cumulative allowance, unchanged deadline 1792122617.77407 minus current Unix time minus stop reserve). Preserve deadline_reset=false and 2026-10-16T03:50:17.774070Z. If expired or cap is nonpositive, return typed HOLD without execution under this allocation.
nodes.action: Stream each needed history/abundance file once with inline SHA256, reuse the earlier strict physical and ledger validation from identical frozen bytes, and calculate the new full-overlap PL diagnostics. Read no ledger/checkpoint files and import no renderer.
nodes.return_contract: Exact command, resolved paths and input identities, runtime identity, start/deadline/end timestamps, exit or timeout state, CPU/wall/RSS measurements, cumulative debit, stdout/stderr, PAIR_DIAGNOSTICS_RECEIPT.json and finite continuous JSON/CSV outputs when completed.
nodes.failure_transition: Preserve partial logs and actual consumed debit; return typed HOLD or failed execution with null admitted metrics. Expired retained deadline is HOLD under the existing allocation. A concrete diagnosed repair retains both cumulative budget and the same absolute deadline; neither is reset.

nodes.action: Read actual execution/identity receipts and full accepted-history continuous metrics. Check complete overlap, observable mapping, finite values, witness locations, integral relations and differences from retained sampled summaries using the adopted PL contract.
nodes.admission_ceiling: PASS_SCOPED for saved-PL pair diagnostics only. No continuum error certificate, interpolation-error estimate, time/angular convergence, D activation or Bianchi admission follows from this node.
nodes.pass_next: Return scoped result to the canonical campaign owner; choose subsequent physics/convergence work through the existing canonical DAG
nodes.stopping_rule: One concrete finding permits one bounded targeted repair and related check; resolved evidence is reused without recursive review or render replay. Missing true-convergence evidence stays with its existing canonical node.
